name: MonarchSavingsPanel
title: SavingsPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard with a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of MonarchText, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchMoney and androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow rows; MonarchLoadingState, MonarchErrorState and MonarchEmptyState
summary: What unused items cost to keep: a headline count and renewal cost per currency, the reasons they count as unused, the decisions made so far, what letting them lapse saves, and the top items.
whenToUse: On a dashboard or a portfolio screen, to show what unused domains, licenses or subscriptions will cost at renewal and how the review is going.
whenNotToUse: For all upcoming renewals with owners and actions, use MonarchRenewalsPanel. For a full list of subscriptions, use MonarchSubscriptionsTable.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchSavingsPanel(unusedCount: Int, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, costs: List<MonarchSavingsAmount> = emptyList(), unpricedCount: Int = 0, categories: List<MonarchSavingsCategory> = emptyList(), decisions: List<MonarchSavingsDecisionCount> = emptyList(), potentialSavings: List<MonarchSavingsAmount> = emptyList(), items: List<MonarchSavingsItem> = emptyList(), maxItems: Int = MonarchSavingsPanelDefaults.MAX_ITEMS, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = null, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, locale: Locale? = null, loading: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, retrying: Boolean = false, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onCategoryClick: ((MonarchSavingsCategory) -> Unit)? = null, onItemClick: ((MonarchSavingsItem) -> Unit)? = null, emptyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSavingsPanelLabels = MonarchSavingsPanelLabels())
object MonarchSavingsPanelDefaults { const val MAX_ITEMS: Int = 6 }
class MonarchSavingsCategory(id: String, count: Int, label: String? = null)
class MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: String, label: String, count: Int)
class MonarchSavingsItem(id: String, name: String, category: String? = null, dateMillis: Long? = null, amount: MonarchSavingsAmount? = null, unpriced: Boolean = false, decision: String? = null)

class MonarchSavingsPanelLabels(title: String? = null, headline: ((Int, String?, Int) -> String)? = null, categories: String? = null, decisions: String? = null, potentialSavings: ((String) -> String)? = null, items: String? = null, more: ((Int) -> String)? = null, unpriced: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null, loading: String? = null)

options.name: unusedCount
options.description: The number of unused items. 0 shows the empty state.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the card.

options.name: costs
options.description: The renewal cost of the unused items, one entry per currency, joined with plus signs in the headline.

options.name: unpricedCount
options.description: Unused items without a price, counted in the headline, never estimated.

options.name: categories
options.description: The unused items grouped by reason, shown as status badges with counts; groups with 0 are left out.

options.name: decisions
options.description: The number of items per decision, written as one line: "Keep 2 · Let lapse 3".

options.name: potentialSavings
options.description: What letting the marked items lapse saves, per currency.

options.name: items
options.description: The unused items to list, most urgent first.

options.name: maxItems
options.description: The most items listed; the rest are counted as "and N more".

options.name: registry
options.description: The statuses of category and decision keys. A key found nowhere is neutral, labelled from the key.

options.name: title
options.description: The card title. null uses "Savings".

options.name: description
options.description: Help text under the title.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts and dates. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a loading state named "Loading savings" in place of the content.

options.name: error
options.description: Shows the error state with this message; an empty string shows only the title. Wins over loading.

options.name: retrying
options.description: The retry of the error state is running.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error state.

options.name: onCategoryClick
options.description: Makes each category a button, for example to open the filtered list. Replaces the web href.

options.name: onItemClick
options.description: Makes each listed item a button that opens it. Replaces the web href and renderLink.

options.name: emptyIcon
options.description: An icon for the empty state. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: actions
options.description: Header actions of the card, such as Review all.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the headline.

states.name: content
states.description: The headline in the strong body style, category badges with counts, the decision line in the muted color, the savings line in the strong success color, and up to maxItems rows.

states.name: more
states.description: When there are more items than maxItems, "and N more" under the list.

states.name: pressable
states.description: With onCategoryClick or onItemClick, categories and rows are buttons at least 48dp tall with a focus ring.

states.name: error
states.description: "Savings could not be loaded." with the app's message and Try again.

states.name: empty
states.description: unusedCount 0: a success empty state, "Nothing unused".

appearance: A MonarchSectionCard with text in the default and muted colors, status badges in their tones (categories subtle, item categories outline), subtle dividers between rows and the savings line in the strong success color, which is also written in words. The same in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web SavingsPanel is a section with links, ReactNode slots and a skeleton. On Android the hrefs and renderLink become onCategoryClick and onItemClick, amounts are BigDecimal in major units (no minorUnits), and dates are epoch milliseconds (UTC) written with android.icu.text.DateFormat without a timeZone parameter. The web distinguishes amount null ("No price") from undefined (nothing); here that is MonarchSavingsItem.unpriced. The parity map named LazyColumn rows; the panel is a Column inside a MonarchSectionCard so it can sit in the screen's verticalScroll, and the list is capped by maxItems. The parity map listed badge as a dependency; categories and decisions use MonarchStatusBadge with a registry, as on the web. The savings line is in the strong success color; the web leaves it in the default color. iOS has not built SavingsPanel yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: The headline is plain text that TalkBack reads in full: "3 unused items cost $120.00 + €80.00 to renew (1 without a price).".
The categories are a traversal group named "Unused by reason"; each category is one element read as its label and count, "Parked, 2", and a button with onCategoryClick.
The decision line is read with its prefix: "Decisions: Keep 1 · Review 1".
The item list is a traversal group named "Unused items"; each row is one element read in words: name, category, date, amount or "No price", decision.
Pressable categories and rows keep a 48dp touch target and draw a focus ring.
Statuses and savings are always written in words, never shown by color alone.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0; right to left, the facts of a row mirror.
edgeCases: Costs in several currencies are joined with plus signs, never converted or added.
A category with a count of 0 is left out.
maxItems below 0 counts as 0, so every item is counted as "more".
An unknown status key is neutral with a label made from the key ("no_website" gives "No website").

examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchSavingsPanel(
    unusedCount = {{unusedCount}},
    costs = listOf(
        MonarchSavingsAmount(BigDecimal("{{costs.0.amount|raw}}"), {{costs.0.currency}}),
        MonarchSavingsAmount(BigDecimal("{{costs.1.amount|raw}}"), {{costs.1.currency}}),
    ),
    unpricedCount = {{unpricedCount}},
    categories = listOf(
        MonarchSavingsCategory({{categories.0.id}}, {{categories.0.count}}),
        MonarchSavingsCategory({{categories.1.id}}, {{categories.1.count}}),
    ),
    decisions = listOf(
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount({{decisions.0.id}}, {{decisions.0.label}}, {{decisions.0.count}}),
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount({{decisions.1.id}}, {{decisions.1.label}}, {{decisions.1.count}}),
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount({{decisions.2.id}}, {{decisions.2.label}}, {{decisions.2.count}}),
    ),
    potentialSavings = listOf(MonarchSavingsAmount(BigDecimal("{{potentialSavings.0.amount|raw}}"), {{potentialSavings.0.currency}})),
    items = listOf(
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id = {{items.0.id}},
            name = {{items.0.name}},
            category = {{items.0.category}},
            dateMillis = {{items.0.date|millis}},
            amount = MonarchSavingsAmount(BigDecimal("{{items.0.amount|raw}}"), {{items.0.currency}}),
            decision = {{items.0.decision}},
        ),
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id = {{items.1.id}},
            name = {{items.1.name}},
            category = {{items.1.category}},
            dateMillis = {{items.1.date|millis}},
            unpriced = {{items.1.unpriced}},
            decision = {{items.1.decision}},
        ),
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id = {{items.2.id}},
            name = {{items.2.name}},
            category = {{items.2.category}},
            dateMillis = {{items.2.date|millis}},
            amount = MonarchSavingsAmount(BigDecimal("{{items.2.amount|raw}}"), {{items.2.currency}}),
            decision = {{items.2.decision}},
        ),
    ),
    registry = registry,
    description = {{description}},
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    actions = {
        MonarchLink(text = {{actionLabel}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone)
    },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
val registry = MonarchStatusRegistry(
    mapOf(
        {{statuses.0.id}} to MonarchStatusDefinition({{statuses.0.label}}, {{statuses.0.tone|tone}}),
        {{statuses.1.id}} to MonarchStatusDefinition({{statuses.1.label}}, {{statuses.1.tone|tone}}),
        {{statuses.2.id}} to MonarchStatusDefinition({{statuses.2.label}}, {{statuses.2.tone|tone}}),
        {{statuses.3.id}} to MonarchStatusDefinition({{statuses.3.label}}, {{statuses.3.tone|tone}}),
        {{statuses.4.id}} to MonarchStatusDefinition({{statuses.4.label}}, {{statuses.4.tone|tone}}),
        {{statuses.5.id}} to MonarchStatusDefinition({{statuses.5.label}}, {{statuses.5.tone|tone}}),
    ),
)
examples.setup:
val registry = MonarchStatusRegistry(
    mapOf(
        "parked" to MonarchStatusDefinition("Parked", MonarchTone.Neutral),
        "no_website" to MonarchStatusDefinition("No website", MonarchTone.Info),
        "no_dns" to MonarchStatusDefinition("No DNS", MonarchTone.Warning),
        "keep" to MonarchStatusDefinition("Keep", MonarchTone.Success),
        "review" to MonarchStatusDefinition("Review", MonarchTone.Info),
        "let_lapse" to MonarchStatusDefinition("Let lapse", MonarchTone.Danger),
    ),
)

parityExceptions.reason: The panel writes its dates as plain calendar days in UTC, which is the fixture time zone, so no time zone value is passed; a date at midnight UTC never moves to the previous day.
parityExceptions.convention: day-granular dates are written in UTC, so no zone parameter is needed
